jp: パルミア王家に仕える歴史研究者。ネフィア迷宮群の歴史の研究に携わってきた経歴を買われ、レシマス調査隊の副長を務める。
jp_grezzo: "パルミア王家に仕える歴史研究者。ネフィア迷宮群の歴史の研究に携わってきた経歴を買われ、レシマス調査隊の副長を務める。"
en: Historical researcher in the service of the Palmia royal family. She is the deputy head of the Lesimas research team, thanks to her background in researching the history of the Nefia labyrinth complex.
en_grezzo: "Historical researcher in the service of the Palmia royal family. She is the deputy head of the Lesimas research team, thanks to her background in researching the history of the Nefia labyrinth complex. "
it: Ricercatrice di storia al servizio della casa reale di Palmia. Le hanno riconosciuto i trascorsi di studio sulla storia dei labirinti di Nefia, e per questo è vicecomandante della spedizione a Lesimas.

jp: かつて独自の理論で自らを神へ昇華させようとして、神とも魔物とも言えない奇形となる。それ以来研究をやめてしまい、研究成果を守るだけの愚者に成り下がった。
jp_grezzo: "かつて独自の理論で自らを神へ昇華させようとして、神とも魔物とも言えない奇形となる。それ以来研究をやめてしまい、研究成果を守るだけの愚者に成り下がった。"
en: In the past, he tried to ascend himself to godhood with his original theory and became a deformity that could neither be described as a god nor a demon. Since then, he has stopped researching and has become a fool who only protects the results of his research.
en_grezzo: "In the past, he tried to ascend himself to godhood with his original theory and became a deformity that could neither be described as a god nor a demon. Since then, he has stopped researching and has become a fool who only protects the results of his research. "
it: Un tempo cercò di elevarsi a dio con una teoria tutta sua, e divenne un'aberrazione che non si può dire né dio né mostro. Da allora ha smesso di studiare ed è scaduto a sciocco che si limita a difendere i risultati delle proprie ricerche.

jp: ノースティリス南部にある、鬱蒼と茂った深い森の中に佇む古城の主。魔石の力を得る前からチェスが趣味であり、家族に先立たれた後は駒たちと暮らしている。
jp_grezzo: "ノースティリス南部にある、鬱蒼と茂った深い森の中に佇む古城の主。魔石の力を得る前からチェスが趣味であり、家族に先立たれた後は駒たちと暮らしている。"
en: Lord of an old castle in the dense, deep forests of southern North Tyris. He has enjoyed playing chess since before he gained the power of the magic stone, and lives with his pawns after his family passed away.
en_grezzo: "Lord of an old castle in the dense, deep forests of southern North Tyris. He has enjoyed playing chess since before he gained the power of the magic stone, and lives with his pawns after his family passed away. "
it: Il signore del castello antico che sta nel folto di una foresta cupa e profonda, a sud di Tyris del Nord. Gli scacchi erano il suo passatempo già prima che ottenesse la forza della pietra magica, e da quando la famiglia gli è morta vive insieme ai pezzi.

jp: 燃え盛る灼熱の塔の頂上に居を構える、赤き義眼を持つ魔法使い。人間不信が高じて竜を夫としており、日々アツアツの生活を送っている。
jp_grezzo: "燃え盛る灼熱の塔の頂上に居を構える、赤き義眼を持つ魔法使い。人間不信が高じて竜を夫としており、日々アツアツの生活を送っている。"
en: A wizard with red artificial eyes who resides at the top of a burning, scorching tower. Her distrust of humans has led her to take a dragon as her husband, and they live a hot, passionate life together every day.
en_grezzo: "A wizard with red artificial eyes who resides at the top of a burning, scorching tower. Her distrust of humans has led her to take a dragon as her husband, and they live a hot, passionate life together every day. "
it: Una maga dall'occhio finto rosso, che ha preso casa in cima alla Torre Rovente, tutta un incendio. La sfiducia negli uomini l'ha portata a prendersi per marito un drago, e insieme passano giornate bollenti.

jp: 赤い義眼のクルイツゥアの夫である邪悪な竜。魔石を保持する妻と共に、灼熱の塔を支配していた。皮膚だけでなく消化器官も鋼鉄のように丈夫であり、何でもよく食べる。
jp_grezzo: "赤い義眼のクルイツゥアの夫である邪悪な竜。魔石を保持する妻と共に、灼熱の塔を支配していた。皮膚だけでなく消化器官も鋼鉄のように丈夫であり、何でもよく食べる。"
en: Evil dragon, husband of the red-eyed Quruiza. Together with his wife, who holds the magic stone, he rules the Burning Tower. His digestive system as well as his skin is as tough as steel and he eats everything well.
en_grezzo: "Evil dragon, husband of the red-eyed Quruiza. Together with his wife, who holds the magic stone, he rules the Burning Tower. His digestive system as well as his skin is as tough as steel and he eats everything well."
it: Il drago malvagio, marito di Quruiza dall'occhio rosso. Insieme alla moglie, che custodisce la pietra magica, dominava la Torre Rovente. Non solo la pelle: anche l'apparato digerente ce l'ha resistente come l'acciaio, e mangia di tutto con gusto.

jp: 癒しの力を持つ女神。胸を可能な限り大きく見せようと日々努力しており、エヘカトルの隣に並ぶのを露骨に避ける。ちょっと抜けており、防衛者がいないと色々と危なっかしい。
jp_grezzo: "癒しの力を持つ女神。胸を可能な限り大きく見せようと日々努力しており、エヘカトルの隣に並ぶのを露骨に避ける。ちょっと抜けており、防衛者がいないと色々と危なっかしい。"
en: Goddess with healing powers. She makes a daily effort to make her breasts appear as large as possible and blatantly avoids standing next to Ehekatl. She is a bit absent-minded and is in all sorts of danger without a defender.
en_grezzo: "Goddess with healing powers. She makes a daily effort to make her breasts appear as large as possible and blatantly avoids standing next to Ehekatl. She is a bit absent-minded and is in all sorts of danger without a defender."
it: La dea che ha il potere di guarire. Ogni giorno si dà da fare per far sembrare il petto più grande che può, ed evita in modo sfacciato di mettersi accanto a Ehekatl. È un po' sbadata, e senza un difensore vicino si mette nei guai in mille modi.

jp: 本来癒す側であるジュアが敵を滅するために力を解放した姿。その翼が放つ光は従う者には優しく、敵対する者には焼けるように感じられるのだという。
jp_grezzo: "本来癒す側であるジュアが敵を滅するために力を解放した姿。その翼が放つ光は従う者には優しく、敵対する者には焼けるように感じられるのだという。"
en: The form in which Jua, originally a healer, releases her power to destroy her enemies. The light emitted by its wings is said to be gentle to those who follow it and searing to those who oppose it.
en_grezzo: "The form in which Jua, originally a healer, releases her power to destroy her enemies. The light emitted by its wings is said to be gentle to those who follow it and searing to those who oppose it. "
it: La forma che prende Jure, che di suo guarisce, quando libera la propria forza per annientare i nemici. La luce che sprigionano quelle ali, dicono, è dolce per chi la segue e brucia per chi le si oppone.

jp: 服というものに縛られるのを嫌っており普段から全裸。肝心なところは大気を歪ませることで見えなくしているが、それでも目のやり場に困ることは間違いない。
jp_grezzo: "服というものに縛られるのを嫌っており普段から全裸。肝心なところは大気を歪ませることで見えなくしているが、それでも目のやり場に困ることは間違いない。"
en: She hates being bound by things like clothes and is usually fully naked. The most important parts of her body are obscured by distorting the air, but even so, she is sure to be difficult to look at.
en_grezzo: "She hates being bound by things like clothes and is usually fully naked. The most important parts of her body are obscured by distorting the air, but even so, she is sure to be difficult to look at. "
it: Non sopporta di essere legata a una cosa come i vestiti, e se ne sta sempre completamente nuda. Le parti che contano le nasconde deformando l'aria, ma non si sa lo stesso dove guardare.

jp: 上辺ではいつも通りのように見えるが内心は大荒れ。怒りのあまり、気の向くまま風の吹くままに辺りを破壊して回る。歩く天災という言葉がふさわしい。
jp_grezzo: "上辺ではいつも通りのように見えるが内心は大荒れ。怒りのあまり、気の向くまま風の吹くままに辺りを破壊して回る。歩く天災という言葉がふさわしい。"
en: On the upside, she appears to be acting as usual, but on the inside she's a raging bull. In her anger, she goes around destroying the area as she pleases and as the wind blows. The term \"walking disaster\" is apt.
en_grezzo: "On the upside, she appears to be acting as usual, but on the inside she's a raging bull. In her anger, she goes around destroying the area as she pleases and as the wind blows. The term \"walking disaster\" is apt."
it: In superficie sembra la solita, ma dentro è in tempesta. Per la rabbia va in giro a distruggere tutto quello che le capita, dove la porta il vento. Le si addice l'espressione: una calamità che cammina.

jp: 限界まで強化した筋肉が美しく逞しい。腹筋でアダマンタイトの塊を粉々に砕くことが出来る。翼を鍛えられていないのが唯一の不満。
jp_grezzo: "限界まで強化した筋肉が美しく逞しい。腹筋でアダマンタイトの塊を粉々に砕くことが出来る。翼を鍛えられていないのが唯一の不満。"
en: Beautiful and muscular with muscles strengthened to the max. He can shatter a lump of adamantite with his abdominal muscles. The only complaint is that he has not been able to train his wings.
en_grezzo: "Beautiful and muscular with muscles strengthened to the max. He can shatter a lump of adamantite with his abdominal muscles. The only complaint is that he has not been able to train his wings."
it: I muscoli, potenziati fino al limite, sono belli e possenti. Con gli addominali riesce a ridurre in polvere un blocco di adamantio. L'unico cruccio è non essere riuscito ad allenare le ali.

jp: 痛みによるショックで完全にスイッチが入ってしまった。壊れた笑い声をあげながら猟奇的に大鎌を振りまわす。こうなったらどちらかが死ぬまで止められない。
jp_grezzo: "痛みによるショックで完全にスイッチが入ってしまった。壊れた笑い声をあげながら猟奇的に大鎌を振りまわす。こうなったらどちらかが死ぬまで止められない。"
en: The shock from the pain turned him on completely. He swings the scythe in a bizarre manner with a broken laugh. When it comes to this, there is no stopping until someone dies.
en_grezzo: "The shock from the pain turned him on completely. He swings the scythe in a bizarre manner with a broken laugh. When it comes to this, there is no stopping until someone dies."
it: Il colpo del dolore gli ha fatto scattare l'interruttore fino in fondo. Ride di una risata rotta e mena la falce con gusto sanguinario. Quando arriva a questo punto non lo ferma più niente, finché uno dei due non muore.

jp: マニの仮のボディが機能を停止したとき、メインプログラムが超転送されることで起動する真の姿。機械仕掛けより突如現れて全てを終結させる。
jp_grezzo: "マニの仮のボディが機能を停止したとき、メインプログラムが超転送されることで起動する真の姿。機械仕掛けより突如現れて全てを終結させる。"
en: When Mani's makeshift body ceases to function, his true form is activated when the main programme is super-transferred. It suddenly manifests from the mechanisms and brings everything to an end.
en_grezzo: "When Mani's makeshift body ceases to function, his true form is activated when the main programme is super-transferred. It suddenly manifests from the mechanisms and brings everything to an end. "
it: Quando il corpo provvisorio di Mani smette di funzionare, il programma principale viene teletrasportato e accende la sua forma vera. Compare all'improvviso dal congegno e mette fine a tutto.

jp: 見た目こそ大人びた女性のように見えるが中身はまるで人懐っこい猫のよう。よく化身の黒猫といっしょに日向ぼっこをしていたり魚を食べていたりする。
jp_grezzo: "見た目こそ大人びた女性のように見えるが中身はまるで人懐っこい猫のよう。よく化身の黒猫といっしょに日向ぼっこをしていたり魚を食べていたりする。"
en: She looks like a grown-up woman, but on the inside she is like a friendly cat. She is often seen sunbathing or eating fish with her incarnation, a black cat.
en_grezzo: "She looks like a grown-up woman, but on the inside she is like a friendly cat. She is often seen sunbathing or eating fish with her incarnation, a black cat. "
it: A vederla sembra una donna adulta, ma dentro è tale e quale a un gatto affettuoso. Spesso la si trova a prendere il sole o a mangiare pesce insieme al gatto nero delle Incarnazioni.

jp: エヘカトルの中から飛び出した謎の黒いエヘカトル。まるで臨戦態勢の猫のように、間合いを保ちつつ唸り声をあげ威嚇してくる。その目つきは獲物を狩る獣そのものだ。
jp_grezzo: "エヘカトルの中から飛び出した謎の黒いエヘカトル。まるで臨戦態勢の猫のように、間合いを保ちつつ唸り声をあげ威嚇してくる。その目つきは獲物を狩る獣そのものだ。"
en: A mysterious dark Ehekatl pops out of the Ehekatl. Like a cat on the warpath, it snarls and threatens while keeping its distance. The look in its eyes is that of a beast hunting its prey.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious dark Ehekatl pops out of the Ehekatl. Like a cat on the warpath, it snarls and threatens while keeping its distance. The look in its eyes is that of a beast hunting its prey."
it: La misteriosa Ehekatl nera che è schizzata fuori da dentro Ehekatl. Come un gatto pronto alla lotta, tiene la distanza, ringhia e minaccia. Lo sguardo che ha è quello di una bestia a caccia della preda.

jp: 鉱物のように固く鍛えられた身体と大地のようにどっしりとした心を併せ持つ。平衡感覚を鍛えるために目隠しをしているが、時々体勢を崩しては地殻変動を起こしてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "鉱物のように固く鍛えられた身体と大地のようにどっしりとした心を併せ持つ。平衡感覚を鍛えるために目隠しをしているが、時々体勢を崩しては地殻変動を起こしてしまう。"
en: He has a well-trained body as hard as a mineral and a heart as solid as the earth. He wears a blindfold to train his sense of equilibrium, but sometimes loses his balance and causes tectonic shifts.
en_grezzo: "He has a well-trained body as hard as a mineral and a heart as solid as the earth. He wears a blindfold to train his sense of equilibrium, but sometimes loses his balance and causes tectonic shifts. "
it: Ha insieme un corpo temprato duro come la pietra e un animo saldo come la terra. Per allenare il senso dell'equilibrio porta una benda sugli occhi, ma ogni tanto perde l'assetto e provoca movimenti della crosta.

jp: その恰好から女神と間違われることもある男神。胸が内ポケットに入れた種もみで膨らんでいるため、余計に誤解を招く。寒いと感じた時は自分の翼で丸出しの肩を覆う。
jp_grezzo: "その恰好から女神と間違われることもある男神。胸が内ポケットに入れた種もみで膨らんでいるため、余計に誤解を招く。寒いと感じた時は自分の翼で丸出しの肩を覆う。"
en: A male deity who is sometimes mistaken for a goddess because of his appearance. His chest is swollen from the seeds he carries in his inside pocket, which makes his appearance even more misleading. When he feels cold, he covers his bare shoulders with his wings.
en_grezzo: "A male deity who is sometimes mistaken for a goddess because of his appearance. His chest is swollen from the seeds he carries in his inside pocket, which makes his appearance even more misleading. When he feels cold, he covers his bare shoulders with his wings."
it: Un dio maschio che per come si presenta viene scambiato per una dea. Il petto gli si gonfia per le sementi che tiene nella tasca interna, e questo aumenta l'equivoco. Quando sente freddo si copre le spalle nude con le proprie ali.

jp: 機械文明が生み出した人造神。機械いじりをしているとルルウィが決まって邪魔をしにくるので集中できず、困っている。八柱の中では唯一翼がないが、科学の力で問題なく飛行可能。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明が生み出した人造神。機械いじりをしているとルルウィが決まって邪魔をしにくるので集中できず、困っている。八柱の中では唯一翼がないが、科学の力で問題なく飛行可能。"
en: An artificial god created by a mechanical civilisation. He has trouble concentrating when he is tinkering with machines because Lulwy is always trying to interfere with him. He is the only one of the Eight Pillars without wings, but he can fly without problems thanks to the power of science.
en_grezzo: "An artificial god created by a mechanical civilisation. He has trouble concentrating when he is tinkering with machines because Lulwy is always trying to interfere with him. He is the only one of the Eight Pillars without wings, but he can fly without problems thanks to the power of science."
it: Un dio artificiale generato dalla civiltà meccanica. Quando armeggia con le macchine Lulwy arriva puntualmente a disturbarlo, non riesce a concentrarsi e la cosa lo tormenta. Fra le otto divinità è l'unico senza ali, ma con la forza della scienza vola senza problemi.

jp: 核実験の影響で変異・巨大化したイグアナ。見た目こそ恐竜だが、肉よりも魚を好んで食べる。俊敏さを武器に戦うが打たれ弱く、臆病。やっぱり魚ばかり食ってるようなのは駄目だ。
jp_grezzo: "核実験の影響で変異・巨大化したイグアナ。見た目こそ恐竜だが、肉よりも魚を好んで食べる。俊敏さを武器に戦うが打たれ弱く、臆病。やっぱり魚ばかり食ってるようなのは駄目だ。"
en: An iguana that has mutated and grown huge under the influence of nuclear testing. It looks like a dinosaur, but prefers to eat fish rather than meat. It fights with agility, but is weak and timid. It shouldn't eat fish all the time, after all.
en_grezzo: "An iguana that has mutated and grown huge under the influence of nuclear testing. It looks like a dinosaur, but prefers to eat fish rather than meat. It fights with agility, but is weak and timid. It shouldn't eat fish all the time, after all."
it: Un'iguana mutata e diventata enorme per via degli esperimenti nucleari. A vederlo è un dinosauro, ma alla carne preferisce il pesce. Combatte facendo leva sulla rapidità, però incassa male ed è pauroso. Si vede che mangiare solo pesce non va bene.

jp: 食用として品種改良されたスライム。その愛らしさから愛玩用として飼われているものも多いが、人を捕食することもあるので油断は禁物。
jp_grezzo: "食用として品種改良されたスライム。その愛らしさから愛玩用として飼われているものも多いが、人を捕食することもあるので油断は禁物。"
en: A slime that was bred to be edible. Many people find them cute and keep them as pets, but beware: they sometimes prey on people.
en_grezzo: "A slime that was bred to be edible. Many people find them cute and keep them as pets, but beware: they sometimes prey on people."
it: Una melma selezionata per essere mangiata. In tanti la trovano graziosa e la tengono come animale da compagnia, ma attenzione: ogni tanto si mangia le persone.

jp: 普通のプチよりも赤みを帯びた体を持ち、やや力も強い。かつてはプチの雌がベスプチなのではと唱える者も居たが、全く関係なかった。赤い理由は今も不明。
jp_grezzo: "普通のプチよりも赤みを帯びた体を持ち、やや力も強い。かつてはプチの雌がベスプチなのではと唱える者も居たが、全く関係なかった。赤い理由は今も不明。"
en: A red-colored putit that's somewhat stronger than normal putits. Some people used to claim that red putits were simply female putits, but in truth, the two have nothing to do with each other. The actual reason behind their red coloring is unknown.
en_grezzo: "A red-colored putit that's somewhat stronger than normal putits. Some people used to claim that red putits were simply female putits, but in truth, the two have nothing to do with each other. The actual reason behind their red coloring is unknown."
it: Ha il corpo più rosso di un putit comune ed è anche un po' più forte. Un tempo c'era chi sosteneva che i putit rossi fossero le femmine dei putit, ma non c'entrano proprio niente. Perché siano rossi, ancora oggi, non si sa.

jp: 液体状の生命体で、流れるように移動しながら、体内に入ったものを溶かして食べている。ぐにゃぐにゃと動く水溜りがあれば気をつけよう。
jp_grezzo: "液体状の生命体で、流れるように移動しながら、体内に入ったものを溶かして食べている。ぐにゃぐにゃと動く水溜りがあれば気をつけよう。"
en: They are liquid lifeforms that move in a flowing manner, dissolving and feeding on whatever enters their bodies. Watch out for squishy puddles of moving water.
en_grezzo: "They are liquid lifeforms that move in a flowing manner, dissolving and feeding on whatever enters their bodies. Watch out for squishy puddles of moving water."
it: Una forma di vita liquida che si sposta scorrendo, e scioglie e mangia tutto quello che le finisce dentro. Se vedi una pozza che si muove molle molle, sta' attento.

jp: 科学者や魔術士が不法投棄した薬品を取り込み変異したスライム。体中で危険な化学反応が起きており、刺激を与えると酸性の体の一部が飛散する。
jp_grezzo: "科学者や魔術士が不法投棄した薬品を取り込み変異したスライム。体中で危険な化学反応が起きており、刺激を与えると酸性の体の一部が飛散する。"
en: A slime that has taken in chemicals illegally dumped by scientists and mages causing it to mutate. Dangerous chemical reactions are taking place in their bodies, and acidic body parts are dispersed when stimulated.
en_grezzo: "A slime that has taken in chemicals illegally dumped by scientists and mages causing it to mutate. Dangerous chemical reactions are taking place in their bodies, and acidic body parts are dispersed when stimulated."
it: Una melma che ha inglobato le sostanze chimiche buttate via di nascosto da scienziati e maghi, ed è mutata. Dentro di lei avvengono reazioni chimiche pericolose, e se la si stuzzica schizza via pezzi acidi del proprio corpo.

jp: 半透明の肉体を持つ魔物。傷が出来ると、そこから泡のように増えるので、その名が付いた。倍々へと増えていく彼らに埋め尽くされた街は少なくない。
jp_grezzo: "半透明の肉体を持つ魔物。傷が出来ると、そこから泡のように増えるので、その名が付いた。倍々へと増えていく彼らに埋め尽くされた街は少なくない。"
en: A creature with semi-transparent flesh. When a wound is inflicted on them, they multiply like bubbles, hence the name. Not a few towns are filled with them as they multiply.
en_grezzo: "A creature with semi-transparent flesh. When a wound is inflicted on them, they multiply like bubbles, hence the name. Not a few towns are filled with them as they multiply."
it: Un mostro dal corpo semitrasparente. Quando si ferisce, dalla ferita si moltiplica come fanno le bolle, e di lì gli viene il nome. Le città sommerse da loro, che raddoppiano e raddoppiano, non sono poche.

jp: 青みがかった肉体を持つバブルの亜種。彼らが大量に増えた末に、海が出来あがったという学説を唱えている者も居るが、誰も相手にしていない。
jp_grezzo: "青みがかった肉体を持つバブルの亜種。彼らが大量に増えた末に、海が出来あがったという学説を唱えている者も居るが、誰も相手にしていない。"
en: A subspecies of bubble with bluish flesh. Some advocate the theory that the oceans were created after their mass increase, but no one is taking them seriously.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies of bubble with bluish flesh. Some advocate the theory that the oceans were created after their mass increase, but no one is taking them seriously. "
it: Una sottospecie di bolla dal corpo tendente all'azzurro. C'è chi sostiene la teoria che il mare sia nato dopo che loro si erano moltiplicate a dismisura, ma non lo prende sul serio nessuno.

jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。筋肉だけが異常発達し、原型がなくなってしまった。町を滅ぼした事例は数知れず、危険な魔物として警戒されている。
jp_grezzo: "進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種。筋肉だけが異常発達し、原型がなくなってしまった。町を滅ぼした事例は数知れず、危険な魔物として警戒されている。"
en: A subspecies of dragon born during the evolutionary process. Only the muscles have developed abnormally and the original form are no longer. It has destroyed countless towns and is regarded as a dangerous demon.
en_grezzo: "A subspecies of dragon born during the evolutionary process. Only the muscles have developed abnormally and the original form are no longer. It has destroyed countless towns and is regarded as a dangerous demon."
it: Una sottospecie di drago nata lungo il cammino dell'evoluzione. Solo i muscoli le si sono sviluppati in modo anomalo, e della forma di partenza non è rimasto niente. Le città che ha distrutto non si contano, e la si teme come un mostro pericoloso.

jp: 地下遺跡から発見された謎の機械。ナノマシンによる修復機能がバグで暴走しており、故障部位から自らと全く同じコピーを作り出してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "地下遺跡から発見された謎の機械。ナノマシンによる修復機能がバグで暴走しており、故障部位から自らと全く同じコピーを作り出してしまう。"
en: Mysterious machine discovered in underground ruins. Its nanomachine repair function has run amok due to a bug, and it creates an identical copy of itself from the faulty part.
en_grezzo: "Mysterious machine discovered in underground ruins. Its nanomachine repair function has run amok due to a bug, and it creates an identical copy of itself from the faulty part. "
it: Una macchina misteriosa ritrovata in certe rovine sotterranee. La sua funzione di riparazione a nanomacchine è impazzita per un difetto, e dalla parte guasta produce una copia identica a sé stessa.

jp: ふわふわした毛並みと愛くるしい姿が人気の小動物。少し気性が荒いが、捕まえてペットとして飼う者も多い。食べると美味しいが、愛好家の前では言わないように。
jp_grezzo: "ふわふわした毛並みと愛くるしい姿が人気の小動物。少し気性が荒いが、捕まえてペットとして飼う者も多い。食べると美味しいが、愛好家の前では言わないように。"
en: Its fluffy fur and overall cuteness makes it one of the more popular small animals. Though they're a bit temperamental, there are many who keep them as pets. They're also delicious, but don't say that in front of their fans.
en_grezzo: "Its fluffy fur and overall cuteness makes it one of the more popular small animals. Though they're a bit temperamental, there are many who keep them as pets. They're also delicious, but don't say that in front of their fans."
it: Un animaletto amato per il pelo soffice e per l'aria adorabile. Ha un caratterino un po' scontroso, ma in tanti lo catturano e lo tengono come animale da compagnia. È anche buono da mangiare, però non ditelo davanti a chi gli vuole bene.

jp: 塩を体にふりかけられると体内の水分を奪われて溶けるように縮んで消えてしまう。イルヴァで最も鈍く情けない生き物でありながら今日まで絶滅していない理由は謎。
jp_grezzo: "塩を体にふりかけられると体内の水分を奪われて溶けるように縮んで消えてしまう。イルヴァで最も鈍く情けない生き物でありながら今日まで絶滅していない理由は謎。"
en: When exposed to salt, the water inside their bodies is absorbed, causing them to shrivel into nothingness. Without a doubt the most dull and pathetic creature in Irva. How the species has managed to survive is a complete mystery.
en_grezzo: "When exposed to salt, the water inside their bodies is absorbed, causing them to shrivel into nothingness. Without a doubt the most dull and pathetic creature in Irva. How the species has managed to survive is a complete mystery."
it: Se le si versa del sale addosso perde l'acqua che ha in corpo, si raggrinzisce come se si sciogliesse e sparisce. È la creatura più lenta e più misera di tutta Irva, eppure fino a oggi non si è estinta: perché, resta un mistero.

jp: 負けてしまった者。その事実から目を背けるように逃げ続ける。何に負けたのかは人それぞれである。ただ、いつかは現実と戦わなければいけない日が来るのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "負けてしまった者。その事実から目を背けるように逃げ続ける。何に負けたのかは人それぞれである。ただ、いつかは現実と戦わなければいけない日が来るのだろう。"
en: A person who has lost to something, and continues to run in order to escape from that fact. The circumstances are unique to each individual, but sooner or later, the time will come when they must face reality.
en_grezzo: "A person who has lost to something, and continues to run in order to escape from that fact. The circumstances are unique to each individual, but sooner or later, the time will come when they must face reality."
it: Uno che ha perso. E continua a scappare per non guardare in faccia quel fatto. Che cosa ciascuno abbia perso è affare suo. Solo che, prima o poi, il giorno di battersi con la realtà arriverà.

jp: 自分の力を様々な勢力に売り込む者たち。雇ってもらうためにちょっとした活躍を大げさに話したり戦歴をでっちあげたりする者も多いが不景気なので仕方がない。
jp_grezzo: "自分の力を様々な勢力に売り込む者たち。雇ってもらうためにちょっとした活躍を大げさに話したり戦歴をでっちあげたりする者も多いが不景気なので仕方がない。"
en: A fighter for hire. Many exaggerate their past deeds or lie about former military service in order to get hired, but considering the current economy, they don't have much of a choice.
en_grezzo: "A fighter for hire. Many exaggerate their past deeds or lie about former military service in order to get hired, but considering the current economy, they don't have much of a choice."
it: Gente che vende la propria forza a chiunque abbia una bandiera. Per farsi assumere in molti gonfiano una piccola impresa o si inventano trascorsi di guerra, ma di questi tempi magri non si può dar loro torto.

jp: 完全にプライドと恐怖心を捨てており、金を得るためならば見ず知らずの冒険者の家にも乗り込むし土下座だってする。それが実を結ぶケースは少ないが。
jp_grezzo: "完全にプライドと恐怖心を捨てており、金を得るためならば見ず知らずの冒険者の家にも乗り込むし土下座だってする。それが実を結ぶケースは少ないが。"
en: A person who has completely abandoned their pride and fear, willing to even visit the homes of random adventurers and prostrate themselves for gold. It rarely ever works though.
en_grezzo: "A person who has completely abandoned their pride and fear, willing to even visit the homes of random adventurers and prostrate themselves for gold. It rarely ever works though."
it: Ha buttato via del tutto l'orgoglio e la paura: per rimediare del denaro entra perfino in casa di un avventuriero che non ha mai visto, e si butta in ginocchio. Che poi la cosa dia frutto capita di rado.

jp: 料理や裁縫に長ける家庭的な人々。いくら野菜を生産しても安く買い叩かれるため、基本的には自分の家庭で消費している。
jp_grezzo: "料理や裁縫に長ける家庭的な人々。いくら野菜を生産しても安く買い叩かれるため、基本的には自分の家庭で消費している。"
en: Home-grown people skilled in cooking and sewing. No matter how much vegetables they produce, they are bought cheaply, so they basically live on the expenditure of their family.
en_grezzo: "Home-grown people skilled in cooking and sewing. No matter how much vegetables they produce, they are bought cheaply, so they basically live on the expenditure of their family."
it: Gente di casa, brava a cucinare e a cucire. Per quanta verdura produca gliela pagano sempre due soldi, e così in pratica se la consuma in famiglia.

jp: 街の美観を損なう者は許さない。塩を常時携行しているため、かたつむり達から恐れられている。塩を撒き散らすことは清掃員的にはセーフのようだ。
jp_grezzo: "街の美観を損なう者は許さない。塩を常時携行しているため、かたつむり達から恐れられている。塩を撒き散らすことは清掃員的にはセーフのようだ。"
en: They will not tolerate anyone who spoils the beauty of the city. They are feared by snails because they carry salt with them at all times. It seems to be safe, in the eyes of the cleaners, to sprinkle salt at snails.
en_grezzo: "They will not tolerate anyone who spoils the beauty of the city. They are feared by snails because they carry salt with them at all times. It seems to be safe, in the eyes of the cleaners, to sprinkle salt at snails."
it: Chi rovina il decoro della città non la passa liscia. Porta sempre con sé del sale, e per questo le chiocciole lo temono. Spargere sale in giro, per uno spazzino, pare che non conti come sporcare.

jp: 街の平和と発展のために日夜坑道を掘り進む。技術も無しに力任せで採掘する姿はいっそ清々しい。坑道に住み着いた魔物に襲われるのは日常茶飯事。
jp_grezzo: "街の平和と発展のために日夜坑道を掘り進む。技術も無しに力任せで採掘する姿はいっそ清々しい。坑道に住み着いた魔物に襲われるのは日常茶飯事。"
en: He digs tunnels day and night for the peace and development of the town. It is refreshing to see him digging by force and without any skill.He is attacked by demons that live in the tunnels on a daily basis.
en_grezzo: "He digs tunnels day and night for the peace and development of the town. It is refreshing to see him digging by force and without any skill.He is attacked by demons that live in the tunnels on a daily basis."
it: Giorno e notte scava gallerie per la pace e la crescita della città. Vederlo scavare a forza di braccia, senza nessuna tecnica, mette quasi allegria. Che i mostri annidati nelle gallerie lo assalgano è cosa di tutti i giorni.

jp: 各地を巡りながら、奏でる音楽や歌声で生計を立てる演奏家。未熟な腕では石を投げられたりもするが、彼らはめげない。いっそう努力を重ねるのである。
jp_grezzo: "各地を巡りながら、奏でる音楽や歌声で生計を立てる演奏家。未熟な腕では石を投げられたりもするが、彼らはめげない。いっそう努力を重ねるのである。"
en: Performers who make a living from the music and singing they play while travelling from place to place. They are sometimes stoned for their inexperience, but they are not discouraged. They just work harder and harder.
en_grezzo: "Performers who make a living from the music and singing they play while travelling from place to place. They are sometimes stoned for their inexperience, but they are not discouraged. They just work harder and harder."
it: Musicisti che girano di posto in posto e campano con la musica che suonano e con la voce che cantano. Quando il braccio è acerbo si prendono anche qualche sassata, ma non si perdono d'animo: si impegnano ancora di più.

jp: 男女の境なく「修道女」と統一されて呼ばれる。禁欲生活を送っているが、様々な欲が溢れかえる聖夜祭を無事に超えられる者は少ない。
jp_grezzo: "男女の境なく「修道女」と統一されて呼ばれる。禁欲生活を送っているが、様々な欲が溢れかえる聖夜祭を無事に超えられる者は少ない。"
en: Regardless of gender, they are uniformly referred to as 'nuns'. They lead a life of celibacy, but few of them make it past the Feast of the Holy Nights, which is overflowing with various desires.
en_grezzo: "Regardless of gender, they are uniformly referred to as 'nuns'. They lead a life of celibacy, but few of them make it past the Feast of the Holy Nights, which is overflowing with various desires."
it: Uomini e donne senza distinzione vengono chiamati tutti allo stesso modo, monache. Conducono una vita di castità, ma pochi arrivano in fondo alla festa della notte santa, dove i desideri di ogni sorta traboccano.

jp: 年末の祭りに舞い降りた聖なる獣であり、中の人など居ない。頭を噛まれるとその年は無病息災に過ごせるという迷信がある。ガチガチと歯を打ち鳴らすのがちょっと怖い。
jp_grezzo: "年末の祭りに舞い降りた聖なる獣であり、中の人など居ない。頭を噛まれるとその年は無病息災に過ごせるという迷信がある。ガチガチと歯を打ち鳴らすのがちょっと怖い。"
en: It is a sacred beast that descends on the end of year festivals and has no insides. There is a superstition that if you are bitten on the head, you will live a year without illness. The clattering of its teeth is a little scary, though.
en_grezzo: "It is a sacred beast that descends on the end of year festivals and has no insides. There is a superstition that if you are bitten on the head, you will live a year without illness. The clattering of its teeth is a little scary, though."
it: La bestia sacra che scende alla festa di fine anno, e dentro non c'è nessuno. C'è la superstizione che se ti morde la testa passi l'anno senza malattie. Il modo in cui batte i denti, però, mette un po' di paura.

jp: クマの着ぐるみに身を包み、人々に改宗を勧めるアルバイト。成績に応じてボーナスが出るので、言いくるめやすそうな人を見かけるとすかさず声をかけてくる。
jp_grezzo: "クマの着ぐるみに身を包み、人々に改宗を勧めるアルバイト。成績に応じてボーナスが出るので、言いくるめやすそうな人を見かけるとすかさず声をかけてくる。"
en: Part-time worker who dresses up in a bear costume and encourages people to convert. He earns bonuses according to his performance, so whenever he sees someone he can easily persuade, he calls out to them.
en_grezzo: "Part-time worker who dresses up in a bear costume and encourages people to convert. He earns bonuses according to his performance, so whenever he sees someone he can easily persuade, he calls out to them."
it: Uno che lavora a ore, infilato in un costume da orso, e invita la gente a convertirsi. Il premio glielo danno in base ai risultati, e così appena vede qualcuno che sembra facile da convincere lo ferma all'istante.
